name: tsrecord-vercel-commerce
summary: Production workflow for TSrecord Vercel commerce: PostgreSQL devices, SePay and Stripe order fulfillment, entitlements, accounting ledger, and server-controlled ads.

whenToUse: When changing TSrecord billing, payment webhooks, plans, devices, revenue reports, or ad triggers
When deploying or debugging the TSrecord admin backend on Vercel
inputs: Current Vietnamese legal and accounting requirements
Existing PostgreSQL schema and API routes
workflow: Read backend commerce documentation and Graph context
Model order and idempotency boundaries before editing
Keep entitlement and ledger writes in one transaction
Build TypeScript and test provider sandbox webhooks
Record touched files and verification in Graph
safety: Never persist production data in Vercel filesystem
Never fulfill payment from client redirect
Never expose provider secrets to clients
Never hardcode one universal Vietnamese tax rate
